{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (e.g., >75% above recent high) by 10-20% in next 5-7 days.",
    "Adjust downward if sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., -0.20 or below) for 3+ consecutive days, especially near 60-70% price levels.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >15% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 5-10% in next 3-5 days.",
    "Increase downward bias if sentiment history includes 0.33+ positive sentiment followed by 0.00/–0.20 for 3+ days — indicates overconfidence.",
    "For horizon >30d, reduce forecast volatility if sentiment is neutral or negative — avoid overreacting to short-term noise.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., 5-10% gap over 5+ days), reduce forecast by 5-10% for next 7d unless sentiment shifts upward.",
    "If forecast peaks near 70-75% and true outcome drops below 65%, apply downward correction of 5-10% for next 5d unless sentiment reverses."
  ]
}
